comment: Deterministic screenshot scenes. Serve the game (node serve.ts), open each URL, wait for window.__shotReady === true, then capture the 1280x720 canvas. Every scene is the real game flown by an autopilot (game/src/shots.js); captures are unedited renders.

shots.name: 1-cover
shots.shows: Climbing out over the valley — chase view, lit HUD (ALT/SPD/HDG), gate 1 ahead at eye level, waiting gates up the course

shots.name: 2-rings
shots.shows: Ring Run — through gate 1, lining up gate 2 over the river, combo on the HUD

shots.name: 3-cargo
shots.shows: Cargo Drop — parcel away under parachute, target rings on the drop field below

shots.name: 4-landing
shots.shows: Landing Challenge — final approach, threshold markings and PAPI lights ahead
